{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Wood Dragon''' (甲辰, ''kinoe tatsu''; onyomi ''kōshin'') is the 41st of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 41st of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Water Rabbit|ja|癸卯}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Wood Snake|ja|乙巳}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''甲'' is Yang Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''辰'' (Dragon) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Wood Dragon (甲辰)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jiǎchén
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaap3 san4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kinoe-tatsu
*** On'yomi: kōshin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gapjin (갑진)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Giáp Thìn

==Months of Yang Wood Dragon==
In years where the last digit is 2 or 7 (where the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} is {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)}}), the month of {{ill|March|en|March|qid=Q110|lt=March}} is a Kōshin month. However, this may also be calculated using the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} months or the {{ill|Solar term|af|Sontermyn|ar|فصل شمسي|ast|Términos solares|cdo|Cáik-ké|cs|24 ťie-čchi|eo|Suna Periodo|es|Términos solares|fr|Période solaire|hak|Chiet-hì|he|תקופות חמה (לוח השנה הסיני)|id|Posisi matahari|ja|二十四節気|ko|절기|ms|Jieqi|ro|Termen solar|th|ภาวะ (ปฏิทินจีน)|tr|Güneş dönemi|vi|Tiết khí|wuu|節氣|za|Cietheiq|zh|节气|zh_classical|節氣|zh_min_nan|Cheh-khùi|zh_yue|節氣|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}}, meaning the period from {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}} to the day before {{ill|Lixia|af|Lixia|cdo|Lĭk-hâ|hak|Li̍p-ha|id|Lixia|ja|立夏|ko|입하|sv|Lixia|vi|Lập hạ|wuu|立夏|za|Laebhah|zh|立夏|zh_classical|立夏|zh_min_nan|Li̍p-hā|zh_yue|立夏|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}}.
